title: OpenEPCIS PPWR DPP Vocabulary Schema
description: JSON Schema for validating Packaging Digital Product Passport data per EU Regulation 2025/40 on packaging and packaging waste (PPWR). Obligations reflect what is legally in force for packaging placed on the market from 2026-08-12: the Annex VII Module A conformity assessment with an Annex VIII EU declaration of conformity (Art. 15(2), Art. 39). Labelling (Art. 12, from 2028/2029), recyclability grading (Art. 6, from 2030) and recycled-content minima (Art. 7, from 2030) are recommended data points until their respective application dates. Version 0.9.9.

Packaging.title: PPWR Packaging
Packaging.description: A packaging item subject to EU Regulation 2025/40, either nested under gs1:packaging of a trade item or itself placed on the market as a trade item (dual-typed gs1:Product + euppwr:Packaging).

hasPackagingTier.description: Recommended — the sales/grouped/transport classification per PPWR Art. 3(1)(b)-(d) determines which labelling and reuse obligations apply (e.g. transport packaging is exempt from the Art. 12(1) material-composition label except e-commerce packaging).

hasRecyclabilityGrade.description: Recommended — mandatory from 1 January 2030 per PPWR Art. 6(3) and Annex II Table 3: packaging may then only be placed on the market in recyclability grades A, B or C; from 2038 only grades A and B.

harmonisedSymbol.description: Recommended — harmonised material-composition labelling applies from 12 August 2028 per PPWR Art. 12(1)/(6); the label catalogue is pending implementing acts (due 12 August 2026).

designForRecyclingMethodology.description: Recommended — names the design-for-recycling methodology substantiating the recyclability grade until the Annex II delegated acts prescribe the harmonised methodology (PPWR Art. 6(4)).

hasReuseInformation.description: Recommended — for reusable packaging, PPWR Art. 12(2) requires from 12 February 2029 a reuse label plus a QR code or other standardised, open data carrier providing re-use system availability, collection points and trips/rotations (or an average estimation).

hasConformityDeclaration.description: Mandatory per PPWR Art. 15(2) and Art. 39 — before placing packaging on the market the manufacturer must carry out the Annex VII Module A conformity assessment and draw up an EU declaration of conformity per Annex VIII, kept for 5 years (single-use) or 10 years (reusable) per Art. 15(3). Reference the declaration document here (oec:DocumentReference pattern).

items.description: Substance of concern using the oec:HazardousSubstance pattern.

hasHazardousSubstances.description: Recommended — PPWR Art. 5(4): the sum of lead, cadmium, mercury and hexavalent chromium concentrations in packaging or packaging components must not exceed 100 mg/kg, and Art. 5(5) restricts PFAS in food-contact packaging from 12 August 2026; compliance is demonstrated in the Annex VII technical documentation (Art. 5(6)).

hasRecycledContentDetails.description: Recommended — PPWR Art. 7: from 2030 plastic packaging must contain minimum post-consumer recycled content (30 % contact-sensitive PET / 10 % other contact-sensitive plastics / 30 % single-use beverage bottles / 35 % other plastic packaging; higher 2040 targets). Uses the oec:RecycledContent pattern.

hasCompostability.description: Recommended — PPWR Art. 9: compostable packaging must comply with composting standards; Art. 12(1) requires the compostability labelling to state that the material is compostable, is not suitable for home composting and is not to be discarded in nature. Uses the oec:Compostability pattern.

items.description: EPR registration using the oec:ExtendedProducerResponsibility pattern.

hasExtendedProducerResponsibility.description: Recommended — PPWR Art. 12(9): from 12 February 2027 packaging included in an extended producer responsibility scheme may be identified by means of a corresponding symbol in a QR code or other standardised, open, digital-marking technology.

ReuseInformation.title: Reuse Information
ReuseInformation.description: PPWR Art. 12(2) reuse data card: re-use system availability, collection points and trips/rotations. No property is required before the labelling duty applies on 12 February 2029.

hasReuseSystemScope.description: Availability of a local, national or Union-wide re-use system (PPWR Art. 12(2)).

reuseSystemName.description: Name of the re-use system or Annex VI system operator; open-loop systems without an operator are exempt from the label and QR duty (PPWR Art. 12(3)).

collectionPointsUrl.description: URL of the collection-point directory or map of the re-use system (PPWR Art. 12(2)).

rotationCount.description: Calculated trips/rotations of the tracked reusable packaging (PPWR Art. 12(2)).

averageRotationsEstimate.description: Average estimation of trips/rotations where per-item calculation is not feasible (PPWR Art. 12(2)); the Art. 11(2) delegated act (due 12 February 2027) will set minimum rotations per format.

PackagingTier.title: Packaging Tier
PackagingTier.description: Sales (primary), grouped (secondary) or transport (tertiary) packaging per PPWR Art. 3(1)(b)-(d).

RecyclabilityGrade.title: PPWR Recyclability Grade
RecyclabilityGrade.description: Recyclability performance grade per PPWR Art. 6 and Annex II: A (>= 95 %), B (>= 80 %), C (>= 70 %).

ReuseSystemScope.title: Reuse System Scope
ReuseSystemScope.description: Geographic availability of the re-use system per PPWR Art. 12(2).
